facts.text: Vicki's been to prison twice, she knows a good sandwich
facts.why: Vicki (Vicky) is arrested after she puts a blade to a man's throat, but the sources opened do not say how many times she has been in prison. Could not confirm 'twice'.
facts.fix: Vicki's got a record, she knows a good sandwich

facts.text: Bobby, you come sit down and eat your gator before it goes cold. Mama made extra.
facts.why: A note in Helen Boucher's voice, not a quote. Fits the plot: Bobby lives with his protective mother in the bayou and the film's gator joke is hers ('all them teeth but no toothbrush'). Keep it without quote marks.

facts.text: Ornery, Mama says. All them teeth, no toothbrush.
facts.why: Close nod to Bobby's classroom line: 'Mama says that alligators are ornery 'cause they got all them teeth but no toothbrush.'

facts.text: Serve the drinks when Bobby hands out the water.
facts.why: Bobby becomes the Mud Dogs' waterboy after seeing the polluted jug and gives the team clean water. Matches.

vibe.verdict: Right swamp shack and a good gator joke, but it leaves out the loudest bits of the film and the cardboard look is plain.
missing: Captain Insano ('Captain Insano shows no mercy', wrestling)
High quality H2O vs the dirty jug (Mud Dogs sideline)
Fool's ball and the devil (Mama's lines)
ideas: Swap 'Bobby Boucher's cucumber lime cooler' for 'High quality H2O' with a Mud Dogs jug gag
Rename 'Bourbon Bowl pecan pralines' to 'Captain Insano pralines' with a no mercy note
Replace the prawns note with 'Mama's right, Colonel Sanders'
Add a donkey 'Steve' name to the hush puppies
